citations.assessment: Sifra gives Abba Yose’s definition of charum, without the epithet after his name.
The baraita gives Rabbi Yose HaChorem in the dispute over the hand used for tefillin.
Rashi explicitly gives the physical explanation and cites Bekhorot 43b.
Tosafot expressly argues for the place-name and rejects the proposed pejorative reading.
The exact baraita is at 43b in the checked witness. Preserve the source’s folio label and compare its two explanations.

holds.reason: Keep the third, mnemonic explanation under Sheerit Yaakov’s name. The relevant Bekhorot baraita is verified, while the direct witness of the interpretive work remains open.
